entries.question: My computer will not start

entries.stop_and_escalate: Stop for liquid, smoke, swelling, sparks or damaged wiring; do not repeatedly power it on.

entries.stop_and_escalate: Stop using a swollen battery, unusually hot connector or damaged charger. Do not use random chargers.
